#### Wait for Nastya to open the door

#### Talk to Nastya

**Paimon:** Wow... This place is... spectacular...

**Nastya:** Yeah, it's super pretty, huh? Gets boring if you stay here too long, though.

**Nastya:** We used to sit here, carrying the booklets Dr. Moreau wrote us and reciting the prayers he wrote for Zhara. I only remember a few lines...

**Nastya:** "Once, I was a firebird, burning on a rusty roof..."

**Nastya:** "It pecks at wheat-grains of flesh, and drinks the bitter wine of thought..."

**Nastya:** "...Until it becomes a silent tree, growing new branches and leaves in the warm ashes."

**Nastya:** Reciting prayers is no fun. I would space out a lot of the time, so I remember most of the places here...

**Nastya:** Huh? Why is the curtain drawn here? There should be a road behind it that leads home.

**Nastya:** Let me see... There's a mechanism that can open the curtain over there... Ugh, it's so high up. I can't reach it.

- **Traveler:** You can wait for us here, Nastya.

**Paimon:** That's right. We'll meet up with you once we've activated the mechanism.

**Nastya:** ...But I don't wanna wait here by myself. You're not family, but I don't want us to split up.

**Nastya:** Please let me come along... Don't worry, I'll stick real close, just like Paimonka...

**Paimon:** O—Okay then. Then let's go together... Who knows, maybe you'll be able to help us out somehow, eh, Nastya?

#### Find a way to move the curtain

**Nastya:** Can we go up there and activate the switch together now?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Let me think of a way first.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I know what to do.

#### Talk to Nastya

The curtains don't budge an inch...

**Paimon:** Huh? Why isn't anything happening? Is the switch broken because it hasn't been used in really long or something?

**Nastya:** Hmm, I think there's another switch on the other side. The curtain should open if we use both switches at the same time.

**Paimon:** Tell you what, Paimon's gonna fly over there, and you two stay here and activate this switch...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** You might not have enough strength to do that, Paimon.

**Paimon:** Can we do it...? Hold on... Let's do it together... One, two, three!

**Paimon:** Yes!!! We did it! Nastya and Paimon will stay on this side. You go over to the other side, and when Paimon gives the signal, we'll activate the mechanisms at the same time...

- **Traveler:** Aye, aye. Ready for your orders, Captain!

**Paimon:** Let's see... We should be able to get through from over there.

**Nastya:** No need to worry. I'll protect Paimonka, and Paimonka will protect me.

**Nastya:** A little tree will be blown over by the wind, but two little trees can lean on each other.

#### Regroup with Nastya and Paimon

#### Talk to Nastya

**Nastya:** I remember this was carved to look like Zhara. But Zhara doesn't look like this anymore.

**Nastya:** We have to keep going, through here...

**Paimon:** Oh, okay! Onward we go~ Hang on, isn't this just a wall?

**Nastya:** This is the doorway to home. Only the ones who are chosen can go through and become eternal life free of all worries.

**Nastya:** Doctor Moreau is the only one who's supposed to know how to open this door, but... But one time, I saw how he did it when I was hiding in a corner of the hall...

Nastya draws a simple diagram and hands it to you.

**Paimon:** Hmm, so this thing is actually a dial. To open the door behind it, we have to turn it to match the right pattern...

#### Head to the door leading to "home"

#### Talk to Nastya

**Paimon:** The dial isn't doing anything... Uh, is the mechanism here broken?

**Nastya:** ...Oh! I remember now! For the last step, we gotta put the "salt" there.

**Nastya:** Doctor Moreau said that for a person to turn into the Perfect Tree, they have to change in three ways...

**Nastya:** "Cast off the soul of the past, and it shall no longer be bound by the hidden veins of the earth." Then, the thing that replaces the soul of the past is... the um... s—sulfur of the soul?

**Nastya:** "Cast off the will of the past, and it shall no longer be watched by the gaze above." And the thing that replaces the will is the silver of the spirit.

**Nastya:** The last thing you have to cast off is... "Cast off the body of the past, and it shall no longer be worn away by the toil and turmoil of the mortal world." So at this point, we have to offer up the material that will replace the body.

**Nastya:** So uh... The salt is... the new body that grows from the old one. Yes, that's it!

**Nastya:** Ow... This hurts a little more than I thought.

**Paimon:** Nastya... Are you okay?

**Nastya:** I'm okay. It hurts a lot, but I'm happy. This way, I can go back home, and you can find the Doctor and ask him about Koshchei.

**Nastya:** So this little bit of hurt doesn't matter... Hurry, hurry up and offer up the salt.

**Paimon:** ...Uh, okay, sure. We'll do as you say. Traveler, let's put this little branch on that platform.

#### Talk to Nastya

**Nastya:** Phew... I'm just glad everyone's okay! I didn't know we were gonna find so many people here... behind the shelves.

**Paimon:** Same... One second it was dead quiet, and the next, BOOM! They just came rushing out like that!

**Paimon:** But hey, look at that new path that just opened up over here.

- **Traveler:** It looks like the way home to me.

**Nastya:** I don't know about that. But looks like it's the only path now, and the Doctor said before, "The only path is the right path."

**Nastya:** So as long as I follow this path, I'm sure I'll make it back to mama and turn into the Perfect Tree...

**Nastya:** The Doctor should be home too. He's never gonna leave. Zhara is protecting him, so I know he's there.

- **Traveler:** Looks like we're close to finding the answer...

**Paimon:** Let's keep going, then... Once we get to your "home" and meet Koshchei... no, Paimon means that "Doctor Moreau," we should finally get the answers we've been looking for.

**Nastya:** Hmm... Once we go through the doorway, we're at home. But...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** What's on your mind, Nastya?

**Nastya:** N-Nothing. I don't know why, but my heart feels a little messy, like a pile of fallen leaves...

**Nastya:** The doctor once said that "the closer you get to home, the more nervous you feel.” I never understood it back then, but now I think I get it...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Don’t worry. I'll open the doorway.

**Nastya:** O-Okay. I trust you.

**Nastya:** Oh yeah... the day the Volkodlak took us away, all of us kids were told to go to the assembly hall. My... My friends were probably here too...

**Nastya:** It's been so long since I saw them.

**Nastya:** Uhh... Have you found anything?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Not yet.

**Nastya:** Same here. Then we must hurry.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** We've found something...

**Nastya:** You're amazing! I haven't found anything yet. I need to try harder!

**Nastya:** The bridge to the assembly hall is right over there. But where is Furiosa? I usually see her around here...

**Paimon:** Hmm... Is this "Furiosa" someone really important, Nastya? Paimon's heard you mention her quite a few times now.

**Nastya:** Of course! She's my idol! Or should I say, she's still my number-one idol right now, and you two are at number two for now.

**Nastya:** You should have a match-up with her when you have the time! Maybe the rankings will change then!

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** A chance to shake up the leaderboard has appeared!

**Paimon:** Aw, yeah! Traveler is a super good fighter, you know!

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** But if I can't beat her, can I concede the match instead?

**Paimon:** Hey, hey, hey — why are you thinking of turning tail even before the match-up has happened??? Paimon totally believes in you!

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** But Paimon gets it now: Nastya likes people who are good at fighting. The stronger, the better!

**Nastya:** No, no, Paimonka, you got it all wrong. I like people who can protect others. That's why I like Furiosa, Zhara, the Doctor, and the two of you too!

**Nastya:** It's just that the stronger you are, the more people you can protect... I think that's why Furiosa said yes to growing branches!

**Nastya:** ...They say she was the first person in town to grow branches. After the Doctor helped her grow them, she got new, stronger arms, and she became even better at fighting.

**Nastya:** After that, everyone started spending most of their time at the assembly hall, while she stayed outside to keep us safe...

**Paimon:** Huh? Is Traveler already on the other side???

**Paimon:** Then Paimon must yell really, really loudly so that he can hear Paimon clearly! / Then Paimon must yell really, really loudly so that she can hear Paimon clearly!

**Nastya:** But where is Furiosa? I usually see her around here... I really wanna to see her!

**Paimon:** Hmm... Is Furiosa very important to you, Nastya?

**Nastya:** Of course! She's my idol! Or should I say, she's still my number-one idol right now, and you two are now at number two.

**Nastya:** But that ranking's just for now. If you ever get a chance to spar someday, maybe that ranking will change!

- **Traveler:** A chance to shake up the leaderboard has appeared!

**Paimon:** That's right, that's right! Traveler is a super good fighter, you know!

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** But Paimon gets it now: Nastya likes people who are good at fighting. The stronger, the better!

**Nastya:** No, no, Paimonka, you got it all wrong. I like people who can protect others. That's why I like Furiosa, Zhara, the Doctor, and the two of you too!

**Nastya:** It's just that the stronger you are, the more people you can protect... I think that's why Furiosa said yes to growing branches!

**Nastya:** ...They say she was the first person in town to grow branches. After the Doctor helped her grow them, all the problems she had went away... And she became even better at fighting.

**Nastya:** After that, everyone started spending most of their time at the assembly hall, while she stayed outside to keep us safe...

**Paimon:** So you want to keep more people safe too, Nastya? Is that why you want to grow leaves and branches too?

**Nastya:** Um... I never really thought about it like that... I mean, I'm so small. Even if I got stronger, I still won't be that strong. All I want is to be just like everyone else in the family...

**Nastya:** Hmm, if we do see Furiosa later, I wonder if she'll still know who I am...

**Paimon:** Oh, she definitely will! ...Hold on, what if she's like Zhara!? What if she thinks we're Badbugs, stomps all over us, and burns us to a crisp!?

**Nastya:** Mmm, don't worry about that. Furiosa will still spar with you even if you aren't Badbugs.

**Nastya:** And burning Badbugs isn't her job... So even if she really thinks you two are Badbugs, you should be fine.

**Paimon:** That'd better be the case!

You fall into a mysterious sewer. Now, you have to find a way to get back up as quickly as possible...

#### Talk to Paimon

**Eye of Graeae:** ...I detect an energy reaction in the vicinity...

**Paimon:** Um... W—Where are we??? Traveler, are you alright?

- **Traveler:** I'm okay. Don't worry.

**Paimon:** Paimon can't believe that scary giant bird attacked us just like that, with zero warning! Do you think that scary giant thing is that "Zhara" Nastya was talking about...?

**Paimon:** Oh! Wait, wait... Are you saying Zhara's only like this to us? Then maybe it's because... y'know... we don't have branches sticking out of our heads like Nastya?

**Paimon:** But we didn't do anything wrong! If anything, we're the good guys here! We're helping Nastya get home, for crying out loud!

##### Shared continuation

**Eye of Graeae:** But to that monster whose sole objective is to preserve the status quo here, our approaching is a form of danger.

**Paimon:** Oh! Oh! Paimon gets it now! It's all because of Goggles' power! That's what's making this town feel so warm and weird!

**Eye of Graeae:** That half-man, half-bird creature named Zhara... and the way the local residents have transformed in both body and mind... All of these feel extremely familiar to me.

**Eye of Graeae:** I can remember now... one of the four who created my body back then at some secret location... He was a leading figure of Snezhnaya's now-vanished school of bio-alchemy...

**Eye of Graeae:** ...Koshchei the Deathless.

**Eye of Graeae:** All these we are seeing are very much aligned with his approach to "life."

**Paimon:** Hmm... So the thing we're looking for is with this Koshchei person?

**Paimon:** Sheesh... This town feels even weirder now...

**Paimon:** So anyway... first we take Nastya home, then we look for Koshchei or whatever his name is, right?

**Paimon:** That's... gonna keep us busy for a while.

**Paimon:** Then we'll ask Nastya when we find her!

#### Get inside the town of Okurov

**Nastya:** ...All I'm gonna do is toss those frogs into his house, and then... wait to see his face when he comes back to a house going, "Ribbit, ribbit!" Heh heh, it's gonna be so funny!

**Nastya:** He's a Badbug... Would you help me please, Aunt LePuy? Would you help me get the key...?

**Nastya:** I've been waiting for you for so long... Zhara is so mad, though. Maybe she thinks the two of you are baddies or Volkodlak or something.

**Nastya:** I saw the two of you just drop into that big, black hole... It was so big... and so deep... Ugh, I didn't even dare to look inside.

**Nastya:** But I knew that the two of you would make your way out anyhow.

**Paimon:** It wasn't easy, mind you... But never mind. Right now, we have a few questions for you.

**Paimon:** Do you have a family member here named Koshchei, by any chance?

**Nastya:** I don't think I've heard that name before...

**Paimon:** No? Really?

**Nastya:** I don't know everyone's names, though. But if you wanna know, Paimonka, you should talk to Doctor Moreau... The Doctor knows everything and everyone's names.

**Nastya:** When you turn into a tree, slowly you won't be able to talk anymore. And everyone else will start forgetting your name too. Only Doctor Moreau remembers all those names...

**Paimon:** "Turn into a tree"... Hold on, so you mean to say that the Leshy here all used to be human!?

**Nastya:** "Leshy"? What's that? Anyway, whatever that is, that's not us... what Aunt LePuy and the others have almost completely turned into are the Perfect Tree...

**Nastya:** But right now, I'm only half-tree... And it's all those Volkodlak's fault! Otherwise, I'd be exactly where they are now instead of being so far behind.

- **Traveler:** So how do you communicate with each other?

**Nastya:** Once I turn into a Perfect Tree, I'll be able to talk to the other trees just by touching their leaves with mine! And my roots will be joined with everyone's too...

**Nastya:** Doctor Moreau said, "Let us become one family, and create a world that is warm and where pain is no more. Let us come together, so we may reach..."

**Nastya:** "That eternal courtyard that is free of all worries."

**Paimon:** (Hmm, Traveler... Might this "Doctor Moreau" really be...)

##### Response branch 2

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** (Ooh! You think so too, Goggles? But what are we supposed to do now then...?)

**Nastya:** Everyone's stopped fighting, too. Even the ones who had been at each other's throats forever... Now, they hold each other's hand in theirs and have become family...

**Nastya:** ...Is that why you two want to be my family? Zhara will definitely stop being mad at you if you do that.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** It does sound like it comes with plenty of benefits.

**Paimon:** (Hey! Are you joking... or are you serious!?)

**Nastya:** There's an elevator over there that goes up. But... "No-Nose" Ove has probably hidden the Control Wheel for the elevator in his house.

**Nastya:** He doesn't like us, and I detest him too. He's not gonna give it to us if we ask for it.
